build_posthog_logger: build a PostHogLogger instance that sends LLM analytics events to PostHog with batching and periodic flush
create_posthog_event_payload: create a PostHog event payload from kwargs containing standard_logging_object with model, tokens, cost and trace properties
log_success_event: log a successful LLM call synchronously to PostHog with request kwargs, response object and timing information
async_log_success_event: async log a successful LLM call to PostHog with in-memory batching and periodic flush to the PostHog API
async_log_failure_event: async log a failed LLM call to PostHog with error information and queue it for batch sending
